text.tspan: Average performance of 15-year-old girls by subject
Average scores in mathematics, science, and reading for girls aged 15. Assessed through PISA scales, which
evaluate children's ability to use mathematical reasoning, understand and engage with texts, and interact with
scientific concepts for practical problem-solving, personal development, and informed citizenship.
